collector_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the primary NetFlow collector.

collector_port.description: UDP port on the collector to send NetFlow records.

interface.description: Network interface to capture traffic from (e.g., eth0, ens192).

inactive_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity after which an idle flow is exported.

active_timeout.description: Maximum active duration (seconds) before a flow is exported.

buffer_size.description: Maximum packet buffer size (bytes) for the capture interface.

ipfix.description: Enable IPFIX extensions (required for some v9 collectors).

sample_rate.description: Packet sampling rate (1/N). Set to 0 to disable sampling.

source_ip.description: Source IP address for outgoing NetFlow packets (leave blank to auto-detect).

uptime_offset.description: Offset (seconds) to adjust flow start time (useful for sync with collector clock).

additional_collectors.description: List of additional collector endpoints to duplicate traffic to (multi-homing or redundancy).

domain_id.description: Unique domain ID (0–4294967295) for flow identification in NetFlow v9/IPFIX.

udp_checksum_offload.description: Enable UDP checksum offloading (reduces CPU load on high-speed links).

include_vlan.description: Include VLAN ID in exported flow records (requires supported collector and kernel).

record_format.description: Flow record format: 'legacy' (Cisco v5/v9 default) or 'ipfix' (RFC 7011).

log_level.description: Verbosity of internal logging: debug, info, warn, or error.
